provenance: Original English descriptions revised by Codex using published appearance-description principles and generic object knowledge, not copied from a paper's description list. Authoring and selection used no DIOR images, annotations, predictions, evaluation scores or prescribed matrix neighbours. This is a rule-reviewed candidate teacher, not a human-expert-certified or empirically validated teacher. Freeze this version before training.

description_policy.viewpoint: Overhead or high-angle optical aerial imagery; no fixed geographic orientation.
description_policy.scope: Single-object shape for object classes; the internal spatial layout of the full facility for facility classes.
exclude: fixed colour, absolute size or compass orientation
description_policy.selection: One coherent, rule-reviewed description per class; no description ensembling or numerical-neighbour optimisation. The same rules apply to Base and Novel classes.

classes.name: airplane
classes.description: Aerial view: a rigid, bilaterally symmetric body with a long narrow fuselage, two broad side wings and a smaller tailplane. The wings attach near the middle; a distinct nose and tail lie along the main axis.

classes.name: airport
classes.description: Aerial view: an extensive paved layout with one or more very long, straight runway strips, narrower connecting taxiways and broad apron pads. Long strips and branching connectors dominate; buildings occupy only part of the complex.

classes.name: baseballfield
classes.description: Aerial view: a wedge-shaped sports ground with a compact diamond infield adjoining a broad fan-shaped outfield. Straight foul-line edges open outward from one corner, while a curved outer boundary encloses the contrasting playing surfaces.

classes.name: basketballcourt
classes.description: Aerial view: a compact rectangular sports court with a straight outer boundary and symmetric markings. When resolved, a midcourt circle and curved arcs around rectangular key areas at both short ends distinguish the internal layout.

classes.name: bridge
classes.description: Aerial view: a long, narrow deck forms a continuous span across water or a visible terrain gap, aligned with its approach paths. The deck has mostly parallel edges; supports or a side shadow may reveal an elevated structure.

classes.name: chimney
classes.description: Aerial view: a compact circular or polygonal top caps a tall, narrow shaft with little horizontal spread. A visible rim or dark central opening may occur at the top; a long thin shadow may indicate height.

classes.name: dam
classes.description: Aerial view: a broad straight or curved barrier crosses a water channel between two banks. Wide water on one side contrasts with a narrower downstream channel; stepped sections or spillway channels may interrupt the barrier.

classes.name: Expressway-Service-area
classes.description: Aerial view: a roadside complex spreads into broad parking areas, short internal drives and several separate buildings beside a through road. Curved access ramps branch from and rejoin the road; a small canopy may cover part of the site.

classes.name: Expressway-toll-station
classes.description: Aerial view: a broad transverse canopy or aligned booth row spans a set of tightly parallel road lanes. The carriageway fans outward into many narrow channels at this strip and converges beyond it; repeated islands may separate the channels.

classes.name: golffield
classes.description: Aerial view: an irregular landscape of long, winding grass corridors, smaller rounded grass patches and scattered pale sand areas. The corridors connect open patches separated by rougher or wooded surfaces; ponds may interrupt the dispersed layout.

classes.name: groundtrackfield
classes.description: Aerial view: a sports enclosure has an oval ring of several parallel running lanes surrounding a large central field. Two straight sides join semicircular ends; the lane band forms a narrow ring around the open playing area.

classes.name: harbor
classes.description: Aerial view: a waterfront complex has multiple long piers or quay edges bordering sheltered water, with repeated narrow berths between them. Paved yards and buildings extend inland from the water edge; the outline combines land surfaces and water channels.

classes.name: overpass
classes.description: Aerial view: two or more road ribbons cross or overlap at a layered junction, with a continuous upper deck and separate approaches. Branching or looping ramps may connect the routes; offset shadows can indicate their different levels.

classes.name: ship
classes.description: Aerial view: a single elongated hull with a tapered or pointed bow, a broader middle and compact structures on the deck. The outline is surrounded by water; a narrow wake or side shadow may be visible.

classes.name: stadium
classes.description: Aerial view: a large sports enclosure has a broad oval, circular or rectangular ring of stepped seating or roof segments around a central field. The substantial built perimeter surrounds an open playing area, sometimes with a running track inside.

classes.name: storagetank
classes.description: Aerial view: a compact cylindrical structure has a round disk-like roof and a curved outer rim. Roof highlights, concentric seams or a short curved side shadow may be visible; repeated similar disks can form a regular group.

classes.name: tenniscourt
classes.description: Aerial view: a rectangular sports court contains an inset playing rectangle, paired service boxes and long parallel sideline markings. When resolved, a straight transverse net line divides the two halves; straight linework forms a symmetric grid within the outer rectangle.

classes.name: trainstation
classes.description: Aerial view: several narrow parallel rail lines run beside elongated platforms or platform roofs. The repeated linear strips form a lengthwise arrangement; platforms sit between or alongside the rails, and a larger building may adjoin one edge.

classes.name: vehicle
classes.description: Aerial view: a small, compact body with a roughly rectangular roof and short front and rear sections along one main axis. Rounded corners and a thin surrounding shadow may outline the body; the roof occupies much of its top-facing silhouette.

classes.name: windmill
classes.description: Aerial view: a slender tower supports a small nacelle and several long, narrow rotor blades radiating from one hub. Blade projections vary with viewing angle; when visible, the tower and rotor cast a thin, branched shadow.
